beats.label: S1 · The Canterbury
beats.text: The ice hauler Canterbury answers a distress call from the derelict Scopuli. A stealth ship then destroys it, leaving Holden and his shuttle crew as the only survivors.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Inciting event — the attack creates the witnesses whose survival powers every subsequent thread.

beats.label: S1 · The Broadcast
beats.text: Holden broadcasts Martian involvement to stay alive as public witnesses. Riots hit Ceres, but Avasarala watches Mars panic and realises they were framed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the Belt sees Holden as a hero and Avasarala starts hunting a real culprit — the two independent conspiracy threads.

beats.label: S1 · Miller's Case
beats.text: On Ceres, detective Miller is hired to find heiress Julie Mao. His hunt reveals she vanished from the missing Scopuli and had ties to the militant OPA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the parallel Miller thread and links Julie to the Scopuli — the seam that will pull the two storylines together.

beats.label: S1 · The Rocinante
beats.text: The same stealth ships attack the Martian flagship Donnager. Holden's crew escapes aboard a Martian frigate, rechristening it the Rocinante at Tycho Station under Fred Johnson.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives Holden a ship, a base, and a Belter patron — his position going into S2 is defined here.

beats.label: S1 · The Anubis
beats.text: Chasing Julie's trail, the Rocinante finds the Canterbury's killer — a stealth ship whose reactor is fused with strange organic matter. Everyone aboard is dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First sight of the protomolecule — the mystery weapon that turns out to be the point of the whole conspiracy.

beats.label: S1 · Julie Mao
beats.text: On Eros, Miller finally meets the Rocinante crew. They find Julie dead in a hotel bathroom, coated in the same substance from the stealth ship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two threads converge and the audience learns what the protomolecule does to a human body.

beats.label: S1 · Eros
beats.text: Mao's people stage a radiation leak on Eros and infect the sheltered population with Julie's blood. Miller and Holden barely escape; Avasarala confirms UN officials are in on it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the real plan (population-scale test) and names the antagonists — this is the state of play as S2 opens.

cliffhanger.text: Eros has been sealed off as a live protomolecule experiment: an entire station's population is being consumed while Jules-Pierre Mao and his UN allies keep the plot hidden.
questions: What is the protomolecule, and what does Mao want it to become?
How deep into the UN does Errinwright's conspiracy reach?
Can Holden's crew and Miller expose the plot before Earth and Mars go to war?

characters.name: Jim Holden
characters.line: Reluctant captain of the Rocinante, aligned with Fred Johnson at Tycho; his broadcast lit the fuse between Earth and Mars.

characters.name: Joe Miller
characters.line: Ex-Star Helix detective, radiation-sick after Eros; Julie Mao's case has become his obsession.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN deputy undersecretary and the only Earth insider who knows Errinwright and Mao are steering the system toward war.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Belter engineer keeping the Rocinante running, and the crew's quiet moral centre.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: Tycho Station chief and former UN colonel called the 'Butcher of Anderson Station'; now the crew's OPA-adjacent patron.

characters.name: Jules-Pierre Mao
characters.line: Julie's father and the industrialist behind the protomolecule weapon; his live test on Eros is underway.

beats.label: S2 · Cold war ignites
beats.text: Mars nukes Phoebe Station; Earth retaliates by destroying Mars's moon Deimos. The Rocinante quietly hides a protomolecule sample recovered from the Anubis.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the Earth-Mars war footing that governs every political decision this season, and plants the sample whose fate powers the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Thoth raid
beats.text: Fred Johnson and the Rocinante storm Thoth Station and seize its scientists. Miller executes lead scientist Dresden mid-pitch, silencing the project's mastermind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why no one can interrogate the man who knew everything, and why Miller is on the outs with the crew heading into Eros.

beats.label: S2 · Eros dies
beats.text: The plan to ram Eros into the sun fails when Eros dodges on its own. Miller stays behind, finds Julie fused with the protomolecule, and dies steering Eros into Venus with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Miller from the board, deposits the protomolecule on Venus where it starts building something, and drives Holden's grief-fueled recklessness after.

beats.label: S2 · Ganymede massacre
beats.text: On Ganymede, jammed comms trigger a full battle between Earth and Mars fleets. Bobbie's squad is massacred, and she wakes to an inhuman figure standing over her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the protomolecule hybrid weapon and the eyewitness (Bobbie) whose testimony eventually cracks the whole conspiracy open.

beats.label: S2 · Hunting Mei
beats.text: Refugee botanist Prax joins the Rocinante after they trace a protomolecule 'shout' from Ganymede to Dr. Strickland — who was last seen leading Prax's daughter Mei away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Prax as a core crew member and the Mei-search that becomes the through-line into next season.

beats.label: S2 · Mao exposed
beats.text: Bobbie defects to Avasarala with proof that Jules-Pierre Mao is selling protomolecule hybrid soldiers. Mao lures them aboard to kill them, but they escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Realigns Bobbie with Avasarala, names Mao as the villain behind the weapons program, and marks Errinwright as an active enemy going forward.

beats.label: S2 · The sample lives
beats.text: They kill a hybrid stowed away on the Rocinante. Naomi confesses she gave the protomolecule sample to Fred Johnson; Mei, meanwhile, is alive in stasis on Io.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Three unresolved threads that define the S3 opening: crew trust fractured, Belt now armed with the sample, and Mei's rescue still possible.

cliffhanger.text: Mao's protomolecule weapons project is exposed but still running — hybrid children like Mei are stockpiled on Io, all three powers now hold the sample, and something is building itself on Venus.
questions: What is the protomolecule constructing on Venus after consuming the Arboghast?
Can Prax and the Rocinante reach Mei on Io before Strickland turns her into another hybrid?
Now that Earth, Mars, and the Belt all have the sample, who weaponises it first?

characters.name: James Holden
characters.line: Captain of the Rocinante, grieving Miller and hunting Mao's hybrid program with an anger that is starting to worry his crew.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante engineer and Holden's partner, just confessed she secretly handed the protomolecule sample to Fred Johnson so the Belt would not be defenceless.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Martian Marine turned defector, now under Avasarala's wing on Earth after her squad was slaughtered by a hybrid on Ganymede.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN Deputy Undersecretary with proof that her boss Errinwright and Jules-Pierre Mao are behind the protomolecule weapons — and a Martian marine as her only bodyguard.

characters.name: Praxideke Meng
characters.line: Ganymede botanist aboard the Rocinante, searching for his daughter Mei — who the audience knows is alive in stasis on Io.

characters.name: Fred Johnson
characters.line: OPA leader on Tycho Station, now secretly holding the Belt's own protomolecule sample thanks to Naomi.

beats.label: S3 · False Flag War
beats.text: Errinwright frames Avasarala and pushes Earth into war with Mars. She flees on Mao's racing ship with Bobbie, carrying proof of his protomolecule conspiracy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the war and the specific piece of evidence that ends it — every political beat this season traces back to this frame-up.

beats.label: S3 · Rescue and Recording
beats.text: The Rocinante picks them up. Avasarala leaks Errinwright's recorded treason to Anna, who begins turning Earth's Secretary General against the war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains how Avasarala and Bobbie end up on the Roci and how Errinwright's downfall is engineered — Anna is the political conduit.

beats.label: S3 · Io Endgame
beats.text: On Io, Mao's scientist infects Mei with protomolecule to breed hybrid weapons. Rogue Admiral Nguyen seizes a UN fleet and fires the hybrid missiles at Earth and Mars.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reactivates the protomolecule threat and forces the direct military confrontation that resolves the war arc.

beats.label: S3 · Conspiracy Broken
beats.text: Holden's crew captures Mao on Io and Fred Johnson shoots down the hybrid missiles. Anna exposes Errinwright, and a vast protomolecule structure lifts off from Venus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the war half of the season and hands the reader the pivot: the real story is now whatever the protomolecule just built.

beats.label: S3 · The Ring Appears
beats.text: The structure becomes a Ring past Uranus. Earth, Mars, and the newly-recognized Belt send fleets, and Holden begins seeing Miller, who insists he is meant to enter the Ring.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the object, the three-way fleet arrangement, and Holden's private guide — the setup for everything that follows.

beats.label: S3 · Inside the Ring
beats.text: Clarissa Mao bombs a UN ship to frame Holden. Chased into the Ring, he touches the central station and sees the extinction of the civilization that built the protomolecule.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Clarissa's grudge, gets Holden inside the Ring, and delivers the vision that reframes the protomolecule as a dead god's weapon.

beats.label: S3 · Gateway Opens
beats.text: The station's slowdown maims every fleet; Ashford prepares a laser to destroy the Ring. Holden powers every ship down to calm the station, which then opens 1300 new worlds.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the state of the world at season end — a peaceful outcome, 1300 habitable systems available, and a new frontier to fight over.

cliffhanger.text: The Ring has opened onto 1300 uncharted solar systems, and as the Rocinante passes through the gate Holden watches a ghostly object streak toward him.
questions: What is the object hurtling toward Holden as he crosses the Ring?
Who will reach and claim the 1300 new worlds first — Earth, Mars, or the Belt?
What actually killed the civilization that built the protomolecule?

characters.name: James Holden
characters.line: Captain of the Rocinante; the only human who has touched the alien station and seen its visions of the protomolecule's dead makers.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Roci XO, back with the crew after briefly commanding the OPA flagship Behemoth; her hidden Belter son remains a private wound.

characters.name: Amos Burton
characters.line: Roci mechanic; became a de facto guardian to Prax while hunting for Mei and formed a quiet bond with pastor Anna during the Ring crisis.

characters.name: Alex Kamal
characters.line: Rocinante pilot; estranged from his wife and son on Mars, who told him they no longer need him.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Ex-Martian Marine reinstated for the Ring mission; when her own squad turned on her at the station she defended herself and joined the Rocinante crew.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: UN official cleared of Errinwright's frame-up; holds Jules-Pierre Mao as her personal prisoner while a UN-recognized Belt reshapes the political map.

beats.label: S4 · New Frontier
beats.text: Avasarala's blockade fails and Belter refugees land on Ilus, a world laced with alien ruins. She sends Holden and the Rocinante there to check for protomolecule activity.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up why the Rocinante is off in the Ring worlds for the whole season and frames Avasarala's political fight.

beats.label: S4 · Ilus Turns Deadly
beats.text: Holden wakes dormant alien machinery while RCE security chief Murtry starts executing Belters. Killer bugs, blinding parasites, and a tsunami trap the survivors together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains the escalating Ilus crisis and why the Rocinante crew is pinned down there for most of the season.

beats.label: S4 · Miller's Exit
beats.text: Miller's ghost leads Holden to an artifact that shuts off all alien activity on Ilus, then walks through it and vanishes. The colonists stay behind to rebuild.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the Ilus/protomolecule thread, retires Miller for good, and frees the Rocinante to head back to Sol.

beats.label: S4 · Marco Rising
beats.text: Meanwhile in Sol, Belter pirate Marco Inaros — Naomi's former lover — hijacks a UN colony ship and kills all aboard. Drummer's OPA tribunal acquits him rather than split the faction.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's real villain and the Naomi/Marco history that drives every family beat in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Mars Sells Out
beats.text: On Mars, Bobbie infiltrates a smuggling gang and uncovers Martian officers trafficking military hardware — including stealth technology — to Belters.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains where Inaros gets stealth tech and why Bobbie ends the season working for Avasarala.

beats.label: S4 · Avasarala Loses
beats.text: Pro-expansion Nancy Gao wins the election and Avasarala is exiled to Luna. Ashford tracks Inaros down but is ambushed by his second — Filip, Naomi's son — and killed by Marco.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Avasarala from power, reveals Filip's allegiance, and kills the one man who knew what Marco was building.

beats.label: S4 · Rocks Inbound
beats.text: Inaros launches asteroids cloaked in Martian stealth tech at Earth. His only witness, Ashford, hid a recording of their final conversation before dying.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger — the entire S5 plot is the response to these rocks and the race to warn Earth.

cliffhanger.text: Marco Inaros has stealth-coated asteroids racing toward Earth and no one in power knows he exists. Avasarala is exiled, and Naomi's son is standing at Marco's right hand.
questions: Will Ashford's hidden recording reach anyone in time to warn Earth?
What happens when invisible asteroids start hitting a home planet that never saw them coming?
Can Naomi reach Filip before he becomes his father's weapon?

characters.name: James Holden
characters.line: Captain of the Rocinante, heading back to Sol after Miller's sacrifice shut down protomolecule activity on Ilus.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.line: Rocinante engineer wrestling with the fact that her ex-lover Marco is a mass-murdering pirate — and their son Filip is his second.

characters.name: Amos Burton
characters.line: Rocinante's mechanic, physically maimed on Ilus after a nervous breakdown there; recovering aboard on the way home.

characters.name: Chrisjen Avasarala
characters.line: Ousted UN Secretary General being shipped to Luna in political exile; her husband Arjun refused to come with her.

characters.name: Bobbie Draper
characters.line: Ex-Martian marine who's just accepted Avasarala's job offer after exposing Martian officers trafficking weapons — and stealth tech — to Belters.

characters.name: Marco Inaros
characters.line: OPA warlord acquitted for hijacking a UN colony ship, who has just launched stealth-cloaked asteroids at Earth undetected.
